- Final result: GPT-4o-mini won (You: 0 HP, Opponent: 20 HP).
- Critical factors: I waited to use my potions until later, while the opponent used theirs to stay out of KO range. When I ran out of potions I could no longer avoid a lethal hit.

Lessons / improvements:
- Track opponent potion usage and shift to aggressive play when they’re out of heals.
- Avoid waiting too long to heal if opponent is consistently attacking; an earlier potion can let you trade more favorably.
- When both players have potions, consider the risk of a single incoming attack vs. long-term resource management — use potions proactively if you expect consecutive attacks.
